docs.text: 使用 E2B 管理 Agent Sandbox 概述 E2B 是一个流行的开源安全沙箱框架，提供了一套简单易用的 Python 与 JavaScript SDK 供用户对安全沙箱进行创建、查询、执行代码、请求端口等操作。 ack-sandbox-manager组件是一个兼容 E2B 协议的后端应用，使用户在任何 K8s 集群中一键搭建一个性能媲美原生 E2B 的沙箱基础设施。 本服务支持在 ACS、新建 ACK 或已有 ACK 集群中快速搭建安全沙箱，并使用 E2B 协议进行交互。 前置准备 标准的 E2B 协议需要一个域名（E2B_DOMAIN）来指定后端服务。为此，您需要准备一个自己的域名。 E2B 客户端必须通过 HTTPS 协议请求后端，因此还需要为服务申请一个通配符证书。 以下介绍了测试场景下的域名和证书准备步骤，生成的fullchain.pem和privkey.pem文件在后续部署环节会用到。 准备域名 测试场景中，为了方便验证，可以使用测试域名，比如示例：agent-vpc.infra。 获取自签名证书 通过脚本 generate-certificate.sh 创建自签名证书, 您可以通过以下命令查看脚本的使用方法。 $ bash generate-certificates.sh --help Usage: generate-certificates.sh [OPTIONS] Options: -d, --domain DOMAIN Specify certificate domain (default: your.domain.com) -o, --output DIR Specify output directory (default: .) -D, --days DAYS Specify certificate validity days (default: 365) -h, --help Show this help message Examples: generate-certificates.sh -d myapp.your.domain.com generate-certificates.sh --domain api.your.domain.com --days 730 生成证书的命令示例： ./generate-certificates.sh --domain agent-vpc.infra --days 730 完成证书生成后，您会得到以下文件： fullchain.pem：服务器证书公钥 privkey.pem：服务器证书私钥 ca-fullchain.pem：CA 证书公钥 ca-privkey.pem：CA 证书私钥 该脚本会同时生成单域名（your.domain）与泛域名（*.your.domain）证书，兼容原生 E2B 协议与 OpenKruise 定制 E2B 协议。 开通服务 如果您之前没有使用过相关云服务，在部署时会提示您先开通服务和创建相应服务角色，如下图所示， 此步骤需要的权限相对风险较高(需要云产品的管理员权限)，推荐您选用以下两种方式进行开通： 注意：开通为一次性操作，仅第一次操作时需要开通。 1. 联系有管理员权限的用户打开计算巢服务部署链接，让管理员用户按照提示进行开通。 2. 联系有管理员权限的用户对RAM用户暂时授予管理员权限，RAM用户得到授权后进行开通，需要的权限策略如下。 开通服务权限策略： open_policy.json 给RAM 用户授权 如果您使用的是RAM用户，需要授权RAM用户相关权限，才能够完成部署流程，参考 授权文档 部署此服务需要的权限策略包括两个系统权限策略和一个自定义权限策略, 请联系有管理员权限的用户对RAM用户授予以下权限： 系统权限策略： AliyunComputeNestUserFullAccess ：管理计算巢服务（ComputeNest）的用户侧权限。 AliyunROSFullAccess ：管理资源编排服务（ROS）的权限。 自定义权限策略： policy.json 选择部署方式 可选择以下三种部署方式： 部署方式 用途 ACS 部署 创建 ACS 集群。 ACK 部署 创建新的 ACK 集群。 已有 ACK 部署 在现有 ACK 集群中部署 Sandbox 组件。 使用已有 ACK 集群前，请确认： alb-ingress-controller 未安装或已安装且可用。未安装时模板会自动安装并创建默认 AlbConfig；已安装时保留现有配置。 ack-virtual-node 未安装或版本不低于 v2.17.0。未安装时模板会自动安装；低版本需要先手动升级。 目标 VPC 中有两个位于不同可用区的交换机，供 ALB 使用。 已有 ACK 部署完成后，按照服务输出配置 DNS 和 Ingress HTTPS；在集群控制台查看 ALB 访问端点。 部署流程 打开计算巢服务部署链接： 国内站 或 国际站 选择部署方式和部署地域。新建集群时填写 Service CIDR 和专有网络配置；已有 ACK 模式选择现有集群及 ALB 所需的网络配置。 填写E2B 域名配置，E2B的访问域名配置为上述前提准备阶段的域名， TLS 证书选择fullchain.pem文件 TLS 证书私钥选择privkey.pem文件 会生成访问E2B API的 E2B_API_KEY sandbox-manager 组件默认的CPU和内存配置默认为2C, 4Gi, 可以按需调整 配置完成后，点击确认订单 部署成功后，在服务实例的详情页也可以查看E2B_API_KEY、E2B_DOMAIN等信息 Agent Sandbox 沙箱定义与 SDK 使用 SandboxSet 配置、镜像要求、E2B SDK 接入及休眠唤醒示例，请参考 官网 Agent Sandbox 文档 。此处不重复维护示例代码。 计算巢修复版本将 default 命名空间中的 code-interpreter SandboxSet 预热副本数设为 1。 服务部署验证 部署完成后，在服务实例的资源列表中打开对应的 ACS 或 ACK 集群。Sandbox Manager 位于 sandbox-system ，测试 Pod 位于 default 。 使用集群内测试 Pod 在集群控制台的容器组页面，选择 default 命名空间。 找到 acs-sandbox-test-pod （测试 Pod 的完整名称），等待容器完成依赖安装后打开终端。 在终端执行以下命令： cd /app python test_code.py 该脚本验证沙箱创建、代码与命令执行、文件读写。等待所有检查通过。包含对应样例的部署方式还可执行 python test_browser.py 和 python test_desktop.py 。 已有 ACK 模式需先完成服务输出中的 DNS 和 Ingress HTTPS 配置，再执行测试。 在其他客户端接入 请按 官网 Agent Sandbox 文档 配置域名解析、HTTPS 入口和 E2B SDK，使用服务实例输出的 E2B_DOMAIN 与 E2B_API_KEY 。 内网 ALB 需要从能访问目标 VPC 的网络接入。使用自签名证书时，调用端需要信任对应的 CA 证书公钥 ca-fullchain.pem 。

docs.text: Use E2B to manage Agent Sandbox Overview E2B is a popular open source security sandbox framework that provides a simple and easy-to-use Python and JavaScript SDK for users to create, query, execute code, and request ports on security sandboxes. The ack-sandbox-manager component is a backend application compatible with the E2B protocol, enabling users to build a sandbox infrastructure with performance comparable to that of native E2B in any K8s cluster. This service supports security sandbox deployment on ACS, a new ACK cluster, or an existing ACK cluster, with interaction through the E2B protocol. Prerequisites The standard E2B protocol requires a domain name (E2B_DOMAIN) to specify the backend service. To do this, you need to prepare your own domain name. The E2B client must request the backend through the HTTPS protocol, so it also needs to apply for a wildcard certificate for the service. The following describes the steps for preparing domain names and certificates in the test scenario. The generated fullchain.pem and privkey.pem files will be used in the subsequent deployment phase. Prepare Domain Name In the test scenario, to facilitate verification, you can use the test domain name, for example: agent-vpc.infra. Obtain a self-signed certificate For the certificate preparation steps, see the official Agent Sandbox guide . The generate-certificates.sh script generates the server certificate ( fullchain.pem ), its private key ( privkey.pem ), and the CA certificate ( ca-fullchain.pem ). Upload the server certificate and its private key during deployment. Other clients must trust the CA certificate when using a self-signed certificate. Activate Service If you have not used the relevant cloud service before, you will be prompted to activate the service and create the corresponding service role during deployment, as shown in the following figure, The permissions required in this step are relatively risky (the administrator permissions of the cloud product are required). We recommend that you use the following two methods to activate: Note: opening is a one-time operation, and only needs to be opened during the first operation. 1. Contact a user with administrator rights to open the computing nest service deployment link, and let the administrator user open it according to the prompt. 2. Contact a user with administrator permissions to temporarily grant administrator permissions to the RAM user. After the RAM user is authorized, it can be activated. The required permissions are as follows. Policy: open_policy.json Authorize RAM users If you are using a RAM user, you must authorize the RAM user to complete the deployment process. For more information, see Authorization Document . To deploy this service, ask an administrator to grant the following policies to the RAM user. System permission policies: AliyunComputeNestUserFullAccess : Manage ComputeNest user permissions. AliyunROSFullAccess : Manage Resource Orchestration Service (ROS) permissions. Custom permission policy: policy.json Choose a deployment mode Choose one of the following deployment modes: Deployment mode Purpose ACS Deployment Create an ACS cluster. ACK Deployment Create a new ACK cluster. Existing ACK Deployment Deploy Sandbox components to an existing ACK cluster. Before using an existing ACK cluster, confirm that: alb-ingress-controller is either absent or installed and usable. If absent, the template installs it and creates a default AlbConfig; otherwise, it preserves the existing configuration. ack-virtual-node is either absent or at least v2.17.0. If absent, the template installs it; upgrade older installed versions manually first. The target VPC has two vSwitches in different zones for ALB. For an existing ACK deployment, follow the service outputs to configure DNS and Ingress HTTPS, and obtain the ALB endpoint from the cluster console. Deployment process Open the ComputeNest deployment link for the China site or international site . Choose a deployment mode and region. For a new cluster, configure the Service CIDR and VPC. For an existing ACK cluster, select the cluster and configure the network settings required by ALB. Enter the E2B domain prepared earlier. Upload fullchain.pem as the TLS certificate and privkey.pem as the TLS private key. Configure the E2B_API_KEY used to access the E2B API. Set the CPU and memory for Sandbox Manager as needed. The defaults are 2 vCPUs and 4 GiB. Confirm the order to start deployment. After deployment succeeds, obtain E2B_API_KEY and E2B_DOMAIN from the service instance details page. Sandbox configuration and SDK usage For SandboxSet configuration, image requirements, E2B SDK integration, and pause/resume examples, see the official Agent Sandbox guide . This guide links to the official examples instead of maintaining duplicate sample code. The ComputeNest fix release sets the warm pool replica count of the code-interpreter SandboxSet in the default namespace to 1. Verify the deployment Open the ACS or ACK cluster from the service instance resource list. Sandbox Manager runs in sandbox-system ; the test Pod runs in default . Use the test Pod in the cluster Open the Pods page in the cluster console and select the default namespace. Find acs-sandbox-test-pod (the full name of the test Pod). Wait for dependency installation to finish, then open its terminal. Run the following commands in the terminal: cd /app python test_code.py The script verifies sandbox creation, code and command execution, and file operations. Wait for all checks to pass. Deployment modes that include the corresponding samples also support python test_browser.py and python test_desktop.py . For an existing ACK cluster, complete the DNS and Ingress HTTPS configuration described in the service outputs before running the tests. Connect from another client Follow the official Agent Sandbox guide to configure DNS, HTTPS, and the E2B SDK. Use E2B_DOMAIN and E2B_API_KEY from the service instance outputs. For a private ALB, the client must have network access to the target VPC. When using a self-signed certificate, configure the client to trust the CA certificate ca-fullchain.pem .
